headline: Lithuanian Startups' Tax Record: 228 Million Euros in One Quarter
summary: Startups operating in Lithuania paid 228.2 million euros into the national budget in the second quarter of 2026. It is the largest quarterly amount to date and 38% more than the previous comparison.
why: Startup tax receipts indicate the growth and profitability of a country's young tech companies, which affects the venture capital and innovation outlook for the Baltic region.
